clientName.title: Client name
clientName.description: Company or organization that hired the lobbyists ("google", "pfizer"). Partial match, case-insensitive.

registrantName.title: Lobbying firm name
registrantName.description: The registrant - the lobbying firm or in-house team that filed ("brownstein", "akin gump"). Partial match.

lobbyistName.title: Lobbyist name
lobbyistName.description: An individual lobbyist's name. Partial match.

issueText.title: Issue contains
issueText.description: Full-text search across what the filings say they lobbied on ("artificial intelligence", "stablecoin", "tariffs", "drug pricing").

filingYear.title: Filing year
filingYear.description: Limit to one filing year. 0 = all years (filings go back to 1999).

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new filings only
newOnly.description: Remember filings already returned and emit only ones not seen before. Run on a schedule to get alerted when a company starts lobbying or a new filing lands on your issue - quiet runs cost nothing.

maxRows.title: Max filings
maxRows.description: Stop after this many filings, newest first.

apiKey.title: LDA API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional free API key from lda.senate.gov to raise the rate limit for large pulls. Without it the actor paces itself to the anonymous limit, which is fine for most runs.
